title: M3.2: Public signed webhook ingress and Slack request verification
description:
Add the hooks ingress Lambda behind CloudFront (/hooks/*, same invoke-key gate) separate from the front door for blast radius, with Slack signature verification (v0 HMAC, 5 minute window, constant time), url_verification challenge, ack after one DynamoDB write, retry deduplication by event id and Slack retry headers. Signing secret in SSM SecureString (shell by IaC, value by owner).

Acceptance criteria:
- Bad signature, stale timestamp and replayed event are rejected without side effects
- A valid event is acknowledged quickly and processed once under Slack retries
- Ingress never echoes whether a team or channel is bound

Gherkin: features/slack_request_verification.feature

Depends on: M2.10, M3.1

Contract: the External channels contract (initiative description; draft docs/EXTERNAL_CHANNELS.draft.md).

Process: Gherkin first (AGENTS.md outside-in). Write the named feature, add it to features/cucumber-features.txt, implement steps in conversation/features-support/steps/, then production code. Vitest only for pure helpers. Both cucumber-js and vitest must pass. No emojis, no compatibility forks, tenant_id on every item, strangers get 404. Product PR into develop with sub-agent review.
